# Pinned wheels for the IVE dictation runtime (backend/dictation.py installs these with
#   pip install --no-deps --require-hashes --only-binary=:all:  into a separate interpreter).
# parakeet-mlx is installed without its declared dependencies: the worker replaces librosa
# (one mel filterbank) and huggingface_hub (downloads happen in the backend, pinned and checked).
# Regenerate with: uv pip compile --generate-hashes --no-deps (MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0),
# once for Python 3.12+ and once for 3.11, then merge the numpy entries with the markers below.
